clips.name: Sunday Pad + Piano
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone synth gain 1.2 · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Piano clearly on top; the warm pad (wheel 0.7) swells in slowly (~1 s) and sits underneath without masking it. A soft C drone (root-5th-octave, no 3rd) fades in over ~5 s. No pitch wobble, no beating between drone and chords, no smear of the previous chord after each pedal change.

clips.name: Building Swell
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Strings speak in ~0.4 s; their vibrato should start late (~0.5 s after each chord), gentle, not seasick. The glass pad (wheel 0.7) adds shimmer on top. No buzzy/raspy saw edge, no chorus wobble on pitch.

clips.name: Prayer Wash
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone synth gain 0.9 · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: A single warm pad in a huge room plus the key drone. Each chord swells slowly; the last 4 s are a long, smooth reverb tail (no metallic ring, no flutter). Chord changes must be seamless: no click when the pedal lifts.

clips.name: Organ Swell
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Gospel drawbar organ with fast rotary (shimmering Leslie) and a pad behind it (wheel 0.7). The sustain pedal holds the pad but NOT the organ, so the organ stops briefly before each change (keys lift at 1.9 s) while the pad carries on. Key click subtle; no harsh distortion.

clips.name: Grand Piano
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → fx.reverb.returnGain · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Clean concert grand in a medium hall. Natural attack and decay, no doubled attacks, no click when the pedal lifts at each chord change, stable stereo image.

clips.name: Rhodes
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → fx.reverb.returnGain · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Sampled Rhodes with a soft chorus: bell-like tine on the attack, round warm body, gentle stereo movement from the chorus (not seasick).

clips.name: Felt Piano
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → fx.reverb.returnGain · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Dark, soft "felt" piano (tone rolled off, soft velocity) in a big room: muffled hammer, no bright top end, the room carries the sustain.

clips.name: Lofi Rhodes
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → fx.reverb.returnGain · drone off · 80 bpm · lofi 0.6 · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Soft FM electric piano through a worn tape: gentle wow/flutter pitch wobble IS expected here, soft crackle, dusty top end, dotted-eighth echoes at 80 bpm. Wobble should feel nostalgic, not out of tune.

clips.name: Dusty Piano
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → fx.reverb.returnGain · drone off · 75 bpm · lofi 0.5 · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Piano "sampled from an old record": vinyl crackle clearly audible (crackle 0.6), slight tape wobble, narrow warm tone, quarter-note echo at 75 bpm. The piano must stay intelligible under the crackle.

clips.name: Glass Ocean
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · 72 bpm · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Glassy pad (wheel 0.7) plus soft FM bells bouncing left/right in a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay at 72 bpm. Bells should ring clearly without harsh 2–5 kHz edge; echoes rhythmic, not a smear.

clips.name: Sub + Shimmer
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone synth gain 0.9 · bass note in C2 range → Bass slot
clips.listen: Split: the left-hand root (C2 range) plays the mono sub-bass, one note at a time (never a chord); the glass pad plays everything and the key drone sits underneath. Use headphones or real speakers: laptop speakers will hide the sub. Low end deep but not boomy or muddy.

clips.name: Anthem
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → macro.intensity · drone off · 72 bpm · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: The big modern-worship chorus: grand piano over a wide supersaw pad, with dotted-eighth echoes. The mod wheel is an intensity macro: roll it down for a verse (piano with a soft, dark pad) and up for the chorus (the pad gets louder and brighter). Set the song tempo so the echoes lock to the band.

clips.name: Gospel Stab + B3
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · 96 bpm · bass note in C2 range → Bass slot
clips.listen: Drawbar organ with a punchy synth stab layered on the right hand and a mono synth bass on the left (below middle C, lowest note only). The mod wheel is the stab level, so you can play pure organ and bring the stabs in for hits. Push the pitch-bend wheel to switch the rotary speaker between slow and fast (it also opens up the stab and bass).

clips.name: Upright + Pad
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone synth gain 1 · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: A warm, close upright piano with a soft pad and the key drone underneath: acoustic sets, communion and quiet songs. The mod wheel (and an expression pedal) brings the pad in and out. Push the pitch-bend wheel up to lift the drone.

clips.name: Clav Funk
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · 96 bpm · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Clavinet with a Wurlitzer layered underneath, a quick slapback and very little room: funk, gospel grooves and tight band playing. The mod wheel is the Wurlitzer level (wheel down = clav alone); an expression pedal is a volume pedal. Pitch bend is off.

clips.name: Music Box Lullaby
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: Music box over a glassy pad in a cathedral, with celesta taking over from C5 up: lullabies, Christmas and gentle intros. The mod wheel is the pad level. Push the pitch-bend wheel to bloom the pad an octave up.

clips.name: Dream Juno
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → macro.intensity · drone off · 70 bpm · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: A chorused Juno-style pad with a shimmer pad an octave-bloom above it, in a huge wash with long echo trails: ambient sets and prayer. The mod wheel is an intensity macro: rolling it up brings the Juno pad up and opens both pads. Set the song tempo so the echo trails follow the band.

clips.name: 80s Ballad
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 0.7 → pad · drone off · LH root C3–B3
clips.listen: The classic FM electric piano over a Juno-style pad in a big hall, with the chorus turned up. The mod wheel is the pad level (wheel down = electric piano alone); an expression pedal also rides the pad. Pitch bend bends the pad only.

clips.name: Synthwave
clips.setup: Key C (Hear-In) · mod wheel 1.0 → macro.wash · drone off · 100 bpm · bass note in C2 range → Bass slot
clips.listen: A three-way split: 808 sub on the lowest left-hand note (below middle C), analog brass in the middle and a square lead from C5 up, with quarter-note echoes. The mod wheel is a wash macro (more reverb and echo); the pitch-bend wheel bends the lead. Set the song tempo so the echoes lock to the track.

clips.name: Warm Pad
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Pad defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB
clips.listen: Warm analog-style pad: ~1.2 s swell, slow filter movement, wide stereo. No pitch wobble, no zipper noise, low end tight (mono below 150 Hz).

clips.name: Glass Pad
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Pad defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB
clips.listen: Glassy, bright-but-soft pad with chorus shimmer; attack ~0.8 s. No harsh top, no seasick chorus.

clips.name: Strings
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Pad defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB
clips.listen: Synth strings: ~0.4 s attack, 1.8 s release, delayed vibrato (starts ~0.5 s into each chord). Should not buzz.

clips.name: Sub Bass
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Bass defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB · roots only, C2 range
clips.listen: Roots only (C2 range), mono: one clean, round sub note at a time with a little 2nd-harmonic warmth. No chords, no click at note changes (30 ms legato).

clips.name: Soft Keys
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Keys defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB
clips.listen: FM electric piano: tine "ping" on the attack, warm body, stereo tremolo; decays like a real EP.

clips.name: Bell
clips.setup: Key C · slot role Keys defaults (gain 0.8, role sends) · default FX, master −6 dB
clips.listen: FM bell: clear inharmonic strike, long decay. Should not be piercing.
